regions.text: たつては卦の灸位に陰腸いづれの爻がまぐれ當るか、相應する内外の二卦にいかなると爻とが選り合ふか特に卦の「中すなばち中央には何がばつたり行営るか、これらの相對的偶然が決定的意味を有つのである。

quote.translation: In determining good and ill fortune (吉凶), it is these relative contingencies that carry decisive meaning: which line, yin or yang, chances to fall into each line position of a hexagram, which line comes round to meet which in the two corresponding trigrams, inner and outer, and above all what lands squarely on the "centre" (中) of a trigram, its middle place.

regions.text: 易の構造はすべての天才約所産の特色として極めて簡易である。

quote.translation: The structure of the Changes is in every respect extremely simple, as is characteristic of the work of genius.

regions.text: 易は簡易である。すなはち除腸なる不變の原理の結合によつて個々の事象を説明しょうとする。

quote.translation: The Changes is "simple change" (簡易), that is, it seeks to explain individual phenomena through the combination of the unchanging principles of yin and yang.

regions.text: 易が「不易」であるのは陰腸の結合といふ抽象的原則の不性必然性によつてゐる。

quote.translation: That the Changes is "the unchanging" (不易) rests on the unchangeability and necessity of the abstract rule by which yin and yang combine.

regions.text: 陰陽の二元が如何に結合して個々の具證的現質を産むかが問題である限り易ば選易」である。

quote.translation: Insofar as the question is how the two elements, yin and yang, combine to produce individual concrete actualities, the Changes is "change" (變易).

regions.text: さうして不易と避易との根柢に深く溶んで易をして易として息づかせてある生命は「交易である。

quote.translation: And the life that lies hidden deep at the root of both the unchanging and change, and that makes the Changes breathe as the Changes, is "exchange" (交易).

regions.text: 象徳に「天地不交、而萬物不奥』と云ってるる。

quote.translation: The Tuan zhuan says, "When heaven and earth do not interact, the ten thousand things do not flourish".

regions.text: 「易與天地準故能彌綸天地之道』といふ抱賃が偶然性を蹄結せしめるのである。

quote.translation: The ambition expressed in "The Changes is commensurate with heaven and earth, and so can comprehend and order the way of heaven and earth" brings contingency with it as its consequence.

regions.text: いつたい周易が積極的相對偶然としての自己の構造を明確に自覺してるるのは成恆未濟をはじめ符に噛嘘や婚の卦である。噬嗑は震下離上で玉Eの形象を有つてゐる。

quote.translation: The Zhouyi is clearly conscious of its own structure as positive relative contingency in the hexagrams Xian, Heng and Weiji, and above all in Shihe and Gou.

regions.text: この卦を理解するには顔の卦との額似から出後しなければならない。

quote.translation: Shihe, with Zhen below and Li above, has the figure ䷔, and to understand it we must begin from its resemblance to the hexagram Yi.

regions.text: 雨方とも口騰に開した卦である。

quote.translation: Both are hexagrams concerned with the mouth.

regions.text: 頤は震下艮上で三三の形象で

quote.translation: Yi, with Zhen below and Gen above, has the figure ䷚, that is, the shape of jaws moving up and down to bite.
